defs.def: a form of sth that is slightly different from an earlier form or from other forms of the same thing 变体；变种；型式

ex.s: As adults we face a version of the marshmallow test every day.
Both the fat and thin versions of the actor took a large amount of food.
ex.t: 无论穿肥胖装还是苗条装的演员都拿了大量食物。

defs.def: a description of an event from the position of a particular person or group of people （从不同角度的）说法，描述
a film/movie, play, piece of music, etc. that is based on a particular piece of work but is in a different form, style or language （电影、剧本、乐曲等的）版本，改编形式，改写本

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 未来，该团队希望开发一种技术版本，可以一次性喷洒到植物叶片上，效果持续植物一生。

ex.s: This new start gave me an opportunity to redefine myself and discover an entirely new version of "cool".
ex.t: 这个新的开始让我有机会重新定义自己，并发现一个全新的“酷”的版本。

ex.s: We can imagine a different version of King Robert’s story.
ex.t: 我们可以想象罗伯特国王故事的另一个版本。

ex.s: In her study, Martin asked participants to rate their attachment to male, female, and genderless versions of a digital voice assistant and a self-driving car known as “Miuu.” It was found that gender increased users’ feelings of attachment to these devices and their interest in purchasing them.
ex.t: 在Martin的研究中，她让参与者对一款名为“Miuu”的数字语音助手和自动驾驶汽车的有性别、女性、无性别版本评价自己的依恋程度。研究发现，性别增强了用户对这些设备的依恋感以及购买兴趣。

ex.s: For example, participants said they would be less likely to buy a genderless voice assistant than versions with male or female voices.
ex.t: 例如，参与者表示，与有男性或女性声音的版本相比，他们更不太可能购买无性别语音助手。

ex.s: A 35-minute hand-clapping, foot-stomping musical version of a Mark Twain favorite returns with this Tall Stacks festival.
ex.t: 一部35分钟、令人拍手顿足的音乐版马克·吐温名作，随Tall Stacks艺术节回归。

ex.s: Thanks to technology however, millions more people have been able to experience a digital version of this painting.
ex.t: 不过多亏了技术，又有数百万人得以体验这幅画的数字版本。

ex.s: But just like our own Internet, the wood wide web has its own version of ‘‘cybercrime”.
ex.t: 但正如我们的互联网一样，“木维网”也有它自己的“网络犯罪”。

ex.s: Some people, however, believe that these new versions have taken away the heart and soul of Shakespeare’s plays.
ex.t: 然而，有些人认为这些新版本夺走了莎士比亚戏剧的精髓与灵魂。

ex.s: It is also very important to consider how each character changes over time, that is, to compare each character to earlier versions of themselves.
ex.t: 考虑每个角色随时间如何变化也很重要，也就是说，要把每个角色与其早先的“版本”作比较。

ex.s: This is something that even the highly successful Harry Potter movies can’t escape from, with fans of the books disappointed not to see some of their favourite characters in the movie versions.
ex.t: 这甚至是极为成功的《哈利\u00b7波特》电影也无法逃脱的，书迷们因为在电影中没有看到一些他们最喜欢的角色而感到失望。
